task: Are ClassifyAutomatic tests enough for the current automatic zoom/manual override workflow? Define the minimum justified backend-to-UI QA matrix.
decision: No. Classifier tests cover the count-to-band function, but cannot establish prepared-count integrity, nullable/manual precedence, request gates, JSON consumers, editor selection, persistence, or stale-response safety.
scope: Completion of the previously unfinished QA answer using retained tool evidence, current installed-tool navigation and independent source inspection. This is an informed continuation, not a new frozen attempt, held-out success, runtime pass or productivity comparison. Earlier task failures and request/byte caps are unchanged.

minimum_qa_matrix.setup: Whole-file feature/coordinate pairs at (0,0), (100,2500), (500,10000), (1000,25000), (2000,50000), and each band with either count independently one over its limit.
minimum_qa_matrix.expected: Inclusive first-fit bands are 10, 12, 14, 15; BOTH counts must fit. (0,0) is 10. Exceeding the final band gives 17. Include low feature/high coordinate and high feature/low coordinate cases. ClassifyAutomatic itself does not validate negative persisted counts.

minimum_qa_matrix.setup: Prepare standalone GeoJSON and a converted KML/KMZ with multiple sublayers; include empty/null geometry, nested geometry, invalid coordinates and failed writes.
minimum_qa_matrix.expected: One statistics object accumulates the whole file across sublayers. Empty/null geometry is excluded; invalid geometry fails preparation. Count only successfully stored features and recursive geometry points; verify stored feature totals before publishing. Persist both totals with format2. Changing viewport extents must not change Automatic classification.

minimum_qa_matrix.setup: In an isolated QA cache, test stored zero counts; missing/empty, signed, negative, whitespace, fractional and overflowing counts; wrong format; missing geometry table.
minimum_qa_matrix.expected: Explicit zeros are valid. Invalid/missing counts never become zero: ReadMeta rejects them. QueryCacheCore consumes ReadMeta and separately resolves policy. QueryCache closes handles and retires confirmed incomplete cache; successful deletion permits same-request preparing/rebuild, subject to the recent-failure guard. Deletion failure remains an error. Metadata-only success does not validate the geometry table.

minimum_qa_matrix.setup: Automatic with either count missing; manual 7 with unknown counts; manual 7 with heavy prepared counts; reset manual to Automatic.
minimum_qa_matrix.expected: Automatic unknown yields null automatic/effective zoom and pending=true. Manual 7 yields effective 7 and pending=false even while automatic is null; when classified, automatic 17 can coexist with effective 7. Reset restores the automatic value or pending state. Missing is distinct from zero.

minimum_qa_matrix.setup: Geometry below/equal to the effective gate, unprepared Automatic at zoom 9/10, and metadata-only requests below the gate.
minimum_qa_matrix.expected: Ordinary Automatic geometry below discovery 10 and geometry below a manual gate are refused before spatial preparation. At 10, pending Automatic can prepare, then enforce its actual band; equality passes. Metadata bypasses geometry gates and, once prepared, returns policy, counts, extent and layer headers without geometry; a cold metadata request can return preparing. Client discovery 10 is not a server prohibition on lower-zoom metadata requests. Geometry requires valid bounds and explicit zoom 0-30.

minimum_qa_matrix.setup: Manual 0 with intersecting feature/coordinate counts at and above 2000/50000, and payloads at/over 4MiB; include a small viewport intersecting a large geometry.
minimum_qa_matrix.expected: Overrides never bypass per-file limits. Exceeding a cap returns tooMuchDetail rather than partial, clipped or simplified geometry. Envelope candidates undergo exact intersection; accepted features retain complete geometry. Verify client clearing/dimming separately.

minimum_qa_matrix.setup: Trace pending, classified and manual policy through runtime spatial JSON and initial/save descriptors into the client.
minimum_qa_matrix.expected: Spatial JSON explicitly emits nullable policy fields; Endpoint writes result.Json as application/json. Client reads and applies policy before geometry. BuildDescriptor performs no cache read: automaticZoom is null, discoveryZoom 10, maximum override 17. Legacy minZoom 17 is not effectiveMinZoom. Save serialization uses the requested map project.

minimum_qa_matrix.setup: Unknown Automatic with saved override 0; Automatic 15 with saved 12; a draft becoming unavailable; no native option selected; cancel/reopen.
minimum_qa_matrix.expected: Keep the existing effective override. Unknown Automatic offers only Automatic and 17; otherwise offer Automatic and automaticZoom..17. Unavailable saved/draft values remain visible but disabled, never silently reset/resaved. No-selection must not become Automatic merely because value is empty. Background refresh preserves drafts; cancel/reopen restores saved selection.

minimum_qa_matrix.setup: Authorized and unauthorized saves, canonical 0/17, explicit null/reset aliases, missing/empty/noncanonical values, and zoom-only/style/no-op saves.
minimum_qa_matrix.expected: Server accepts canonical 0..17 regardless of editor threshold; rejects missing key, empty text, signs, whitespace, fractions, leading zeros and 18. Enforce manager role, creator-company ownership, requested/source access, visibility, type and feature flag. Original-project restriction is UI-only. Store/remove oxShowFromZoom within options; reset need not make the column SQL NULL. Zoom-only saves preserve styles/source/caches; changed saves log, and no-op saves do not resubmit. Style saves preserve the override but invalidate derived caches and clear KML/KMZ conversion rows.

minimum_qa_matrix.setup: Prepared Automatic 15; save manual 17 and reset; repeat with ordinary rejection and malformed success descriptor.
minimum_qa_matrix.expected: Busy editor blocks duplicate save/cancel. Valid ACK preserves known Automatic 15 despite the cheap descriptor's null, applies authoritative override, settles busy state and closes. Rejection restores policy and keeps the attempted draft/error. Transport failure alone does not prove no persistence. Current success callback can report saved even if descriptor parsing fails: test this separately rather than assuming authoritative rehydration.

minimum_qa_matrix.setup: Delay viewport responses across save start, successful/rejected ACK, pan, hide/dispose and chunked insertion; then deliver an obsolete disabled response.
minimum_qa_matrix.expected: Ordinary stale policy/geometry/errors cannot overwrite current state. Save start/settlement change policy epochs; refresh invalidates viewport/insertion work. Disabled responses deliberately latch even when obsolete, clearing work and preventing re-enable. Explicit metadata camera navigation has separate guards: saving alone need not invalidate its camera action.

minimum_qa_matrix.setup: Viewport loading disabled and converted layers queued/admitted/hidden/deleted in both map views.
minimum_qa_matrix.expected: Retain complete-file behavior when disabled at initial setup; a runtime disabled response must not trigger a fallback download. Queued converted layers do not prepare/fetch or expose an active editor. Hiding retains admission; deleting an admitted layer promotes the next queued layer. Confirm actual browser controls, authenticated API and native-cache behavior before release signoff.

relationship_boundaries: QueryCacheCore directly calls ReadMeta and resolves policy separately; do not invent ReadMeta->Resolve. JSON field propagation and ajax action dispatch are source-traced data/transport links, not graph-proven direct calls. Installed Blast has no indexed setZoomOverride caller; its literal recovery finds mapLayer853. Confirming that source call does not establish exhaustive receiver binding or runtime execution.
signoff: Source-based QA planning is complete. All cases above remain to execute against an isolated application/cache and authenticated browser. No application runtime, deployment configuration, production data, generated JS freshness or exhaustive dependency coverage was verified here. This answer does not close the broader Engram goal.
